title: Cobblemon Reload
description: This is going to be a server ran through you, you want you will get we are just the people who make it happen
body:
I’m currently working on the next Cobblemon server. My server will be ran with the players I want to make the experience better for everyone, this is going to be a fresh server there is going to be problems and there are going to be things missing, please take the time to come over and check it out.

Features:

Gts / Auction House

Poke Bingo

Server Wide Tasks (e.g - Catch 150 Water Types)

Quests

Daily/Weekly/Monthly Challanges

Battle pass

Pwarps

RTP

Breeding


Around The Server:

We are going to have plenty of biome warps, there’s nothing worse than RTP spamming to try find the biome you want.

Monuments will have personal loot, I found when playing servers all you find is empty chests, I want to reward the explorers.

We will have a market for selling most items within the game however these will be a set at less what you could possibly sell to others, in hope for plenty of pwarp shops. 

Gyms, gyms are going to be a massive part of our server which means we need plenty of you guys to drop by and get those gym leader applications in.

We feel Events are going to be a great way for you guys to come together as a community and have fun, we will be hosting weekly events at a time and day that’s suits everyone. (Event team applications will be available within the last week before release)
